# v0.1.0 public beta preparation

Publication is on hold. No code push, new release tag, GitHub release, or deployment is authorized. The maintainer must explicitly direct publication after reviewing scope, limitations, and evidence.

## Release promise

The first public beta is v0.1.0. It establishes the current platform and stored formats as the supported baseline. The maintainer explicitly authorized removal of the unintended development release records and tags. The two GitHub releases (v0.2.1 and v0.3.0) and all three tags (v0.2.0, v0.2.1, and v0.3.0) were removed on October 14, 2026. GitHub and the source checkout now have no release tags. All three original tagged commits remain ancestors of main; no source history was rewritten. Local backups of the release JSON, tag references, and a verified full-history Git bundle are in `.git/release-backups/development-release-reset/` (also copied to `/tmp/design-studio-development-release-backup/`). No version-specific exclusions or development-format migrations are shipped.

Installation guidance pins v0.1.0. The separate website's [prepared patch](v0.1.0-website.patch) changes its prompt and plain-text agent guide together; it remains unapplied until publication is authorized. Do not advertise the new tag as available before it exists.

The concise proposed release notes are in [CHANGELOG](../../CHANGELOG.md). The [superseded v0.4.0 preparation](v0.4.0-acceptance.md) preserves earlier runtime and browser evidence, including the onboarding timing fix. That evidence does not substitute for verification of this renumbered candidate.

## Candidate verification

The final candidate is `8d42ad74207a84ebc68a66147c14291326fc2931`. Acceptance ran on October 14, 2026 in the clean full-history clone `/tmp/design-studio-010-acceptance`, with upstream configured as origin and no copied private profiles or work. Node was 24.14.1 and pnpm was 12.8.2.

| Check | Result | Local evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Frozen dependency installation | Passed | `/tmp/release-010-final-install.log` |
| Sync, formatting, module checks, released contract, strict ownership, starter distribution | Passed | `/tmp/release-010-final-gates.log` |
| Full release regressions | 547 passed; no failures, cancellations, or skips; enabled control and all six optional modules disabled and removed passed | `/tmp/release-010-final-tests.log` |
| Actual update CLI | Synthetic 0.1.0 → 0.1.1 dry run, complete protected-content preservation, conflict/continue, frozen builds, and failed-check reporting passed | `/tmp/release-010-final-upgrade.log` |
| Production build and asset inspection | Passed; all manifest references exist; initial JS/CSS 715.1 KiB raw / 87.2 KiB gzip across two files | `/tmp/release-010-final-gates.log` |
| Private tag installation | Exact `--branch v0.1.0` clone, local main, upstream remote, retained ancestry, frozen install, and visible welcome screen passed; browser error logs empty | `/tmp/release-010-tag-install.log`, `/tmp/release-010-tag-install-preview.png` |
| Website patch | Applies cleanly; unapplied | [Prepared patch](v0.1.0-website.patch) |
| Release dry run | Blocked only by local main differing from upstream main; no release created or published | `/tmp/release-010-final-dry-run.log` |

The ordinary upstream-tag cache now prunes deleted remote tags without touching a studio's own tags, covered by regression tests. No historical version names are baked into release selection. The update CLI and private installation checks ran on runtime preparation commit `339b553aed85e9df2db1eddfa47baf81e0474749`; the final candidate changes only a setup-test fixture's minimum version and release prose. The final regression suite and production gates ran on the final candidate.

The installation tag exists only in a disposable local fixture, not in this source checkout or GitHub. This verifies the installation procedure, not availability of a public tag or a clean-computer setup. The temporary preview server and browser tab were stopped after inspection. Existing large-bundle and build-plugin timing diagnostics remain performance follow-ups.

Local preparation is complete. No additional engineering blocker was found within this acceptance scope. The evidence-only follow-up passed `pnpm build` (`/tmp/release-010-record-build.log`); it does not change the accepted runtime.

## Remaining publication gates

- Explicit maintainer direction after reviewing the release and limitations.
- Candidate and release commits must pass upstream CI. Pushing main also deploys the public demo, so preparation does not push it automatically.
- Coordinate the website prompt update with availability of the approved tag.
- Verify installation from the exact public tag and the deployed viewer's interactions, direct links, and reloads before announcement.

## Known limitations

- This is early beta. Clean-computer and new-account installation are not verified claims; prior checks used macOS with existing tools and caches.
- Published studios have no built-in sign-in. Hosting access controls and direct-route fallback behavior depend on the provider; GitHub Pages fallback responses retain HTTP 404 status.
- Large bundles and representative large-studio performance remain follow-ups.
- Repository installation is the launch path. Plugin distribution and additional hosting-provider walkthroughs remain deferred.
